transcript.text: Could you tell me more about your final-year project involving a survey on the use of UPI among shoppers?

I completed my BCom in Lucknow this year. My final project was a survey of 40 shoppers about how they use UPI for small purchases. Most said they use it for amounts below a few hundred rupees but still carry cash for vegetable vendors. I have no work experience yet. I want to do an MBA because I have studied accounts but have not learned how a financial company chooses its customers.
How did you decide which markets and shoppers to include in your survey?

feedback.summary: The candidate provided basic descriptions of their final-year survey project and showed a general interest in learning. However, clarity is lacking in important details about their project methodology, personal contributions, and learning reflections. Some responses diverged from the interview focus, missing opportunities to demonstrate motivation for MBA and insight into their studies.
